CustomField.description: The Outreach Source Code (appeal, channel, or event) that generated this gift. When populated, the OSC's parent Campaign must equal this transaction's CampaignId — mismatched values fail with "Select an Outreach Source Code that's part of this Campaign." Recommended pattern in automation: pick the OSC first, then set CampaignId from OutreachSourceCode.CampaignId. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The appeal, event, or channel that generated this gift. Must belong to the Campaign selected on this record.
